findings.title: TotalDocs iterates over b.cache without acquiring cacheMu
findings.body: `TotalDocs()` iterates over `b.cache` without acquiring `b.cacheMu.RLock()`. This PR adds a call to `s.search.TotalDocs()` in `searchSupport.init()` right after starting the background watch goroutine (`handleEvent`), which can concurrently call `getOrCreateIndex` -> `BuildIndex` and mutate `b.cache`. In addition, once the server is running, concurrent `Search` requests or watch events for unindexed namespaces can trigger `BuildIndex` and write to `b.cache` while `TotalDocs()` is reading it, causing a concurrent map read/write panic in Go.

findings.title: Removing global lock in BuildIndex exposes concurrent builds for the same key
findings.body: Previously, `b.cacheMu.Lock()` was held for the entire duration of `BuildIndex`. By narrowing the lock to only the final `b.cache[key] = idx` assignment, two concurrent callers (e.g., concurrent `Search` requests or a `Search` racing with `handleEvent` via `getOrCreateIndex`) for the same `NamespacedResource` key can now execute `BuildIndex` simultaneously. For file-backed indexes (`size > b.opts.FileThreshold`), the second call to `bleve.New(dir, mapper)` on the same directory will fail because the path already exists / is locked by BoltDB. For memory-backed indexes, both will build in parallel and the second will overwrite `b.cache[key]`, leaking the first index and double-counting `IndexTenants` and `IndexedKinds` metrics.

findings.title: Data race on totalBatchesIndexed and shared err variable in errgroup
findings.body: With `BuildIndex` in `bleveBackend` no longer serializing execution under `cacheMu`, the goroutines spawned in `searchSupport.init` via `group.Go` (when `s.initWorkers > 1`) now run concurrently. Inside the closure, `totalBatchesIndexed++` (line 189) and the assignment to the outer `err` variable in `_, _, err = s.build(...)` (line 190) are unsynchronized writes across goroutines, causing a data race (which will fail under `go test -race`). `err` should be a local variable inside the closure and `totalBatchesIndexed` should use `atomic` or `len(stats)`.

findings.title: Canceled context and leaked resources if s.Init fails in NewResourceServer
findings.body: In `NewResourceServer`, if `s.Init(ctx)` returns an error on line 258, `cancel()` (created on line 229) is never called and any already-initialized components (such as the CDK blob bucket opened on line 208 or background goroutines started by `s.lifecycle.Init` / `s.search.init` before a later step in `Init` failed) are not cleaned up.
